job: Riverside House AOV Smoke Vents (RRR Group)
_note: 2no bottom-hung AOV smoke vents, one per stairwell, at each stairwell's top storey. Priced off A Plus QT51518 supply-only, made supply-and-fit. Requirement source: red note on drawings K1653-11 and K1653-12, 'AUTOMATICALLY OPENABLE VENT/WINDOW WITH A FREE AREA OF 1m2'. Adam ruled on REQ-9 27/07: the openings are being newly formed, so the vents can be made as large as the free area requires - size is not a constraint. CURRENCY CAVEAT: the requirement appears ONLY on K1653-11 and K1653-12, neither ever revised since Mar 24, while the ground floor plan K1653-10b was revised twice in Nov 25. Confirm both sheets are still current - brief C5.

VENTILATOR-NOT-WINDOW TEST (Gordon Court, 27/07) - confirmed A Plus QT51518 prices the AOV FUNCTION, not a plain window: the quote carries 'AOV Type 850mm Stroke Single', 'AOV Cable Direction', 'AOV Colour 9006 Satin', a dedicated AOV Notes page and the SE Controls actuator warranty, at GBP 1,401.24/m2 against GBP 528.83/m2 for a plain glazed aluminium window in the same size band. Gordon Court's BSW quote failed this test - 3no WN_7 at GBP 412.67/m2 and 4no WL_1 at GBP 442.98/m2 with zero occurrences of AOV, actuator, chain, stroke or 24V.

Onward haulage from Fenster's MK13 9HF yard to site at HP19 7HL - QT51518 carries NO site address and is addressed to our own Bradwell Abbey yard, so A Plus's 'Delivered' ends in Milton Keynes. A Plus also require 'suitable labour at the delivery point to unload'.

Structural alteration to form or ENLARGE a vent opening - lintels, cutting masonry, making good. CORRECTED 27/07 latest: NEITHER VENT HAS A COST-FREE RESIZE. AOV.01 (second floor) has no opening in any stairwell wall so a new one must be formed, but 'new' is not 'free' - what matters is what it is cut into, and Riverside is existing fabric throughout (K1653-04 is a SINGLE existing/proposed elevation set, no added storey shown, no new construction annotated, cornice and pediment continuous through all three storeys), so it is cut into RETAINED masonry. AOV.02 (first floor) has three existing openings, so if the vent takes one its size is set. The earlier note that AOV.01's size was 'genuinely free' is WITHDRAWN - it was this chat's own error, caught by Gordon Court correcting the same mistake on their job. Inference from the elevations, not proof; the existing and demolition plans settle it. Brief C2. CORROBORATED 27/07 latest by a second independent instrument: the plans colour-code every NEW or ALTERED wall (new partition, new separating wall upgrade, separating wall upgrade to existing, blockwork infill), and at BOTH stairwells the internal walls are coded while the external walls carry no coding at all - i.e. retained existing fabric. Gordon Court have since withdrawn the WINDOW TAG as a statement of opening condition (their WE_2 windows sit in new stud walls), but that does not touch this job: Riverside has no such tag and the reasoning never used one. REMAINING GAP: no external wall BUILD-UP legend, so we know these walls are not new but not what they are made of - which decides the lintel, the fixing and the cost of forming the opening. A wall type schedule or section is now requested with the demolition and existing plans at C2.

Planning risk on a resize - drawings stamped 24/02303/PAPCR, a PRIOR APPROVAL reference rather than a full permission. Prior-approval conversions normally limit external alteration, so enlarging the openings may need a separate application. HD Planning to confirm - brief C3.

WALL WINDOW OR ROOF VENT on AOV.01 - replaces our withdrawn arched-head flag (the two arched-head windows on Elevation F line up with the Living room's W2 pair, not the stairwell). The second floor stairwell has NO opening in any of its walls and the note says the stair is to be vented 'AT THE TOP STOREY ROOF'. A Plus have quoted a wall casement on a 155mm subcill. If a roof vent is intended, the quoted unit is the wrong product from the wrong supplier - brief C4. THIRD POINTER ADDED 27/07 latest: Gordon Court's NBS names the standard product for this exact duty as 'STAIRWELL VENTILATOR... ROOF MOUNTED ONTO HORIZONTAL KERB... 1m2 geometric free area' - same duty, same 1m2, roof mounted - with a DIFFERENT model specified where a wall unit is wanted. So three independent pointers now say AOV.01 may be a roof vent: the note's wording, the absent wall opening, and the standard product for the duty. If it is, none of Part One of the brief applies to AOV.01 and the priced unit is wrong - roughly half the quote.

PACK COMPLETENESS (Gordon Court's 25-of-82 check, run 27/07 late) - we hold Campbell Ark's K1653-03/04/10b/11/12 plus hd planning's location plan, with K1653-01, 02, 05, 06, 07, 08 and 09 unaccounted for. The plans cross-refer to DETAIL 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 and no detail sheet is held. No fire strategy, no existing plans, no demolition plan, no sections, no window schedule; the OneDrive job folder is still empty. Anything on those sheets is neither priced nor knowingly excluded - the exclusion below is stated on that basis. Fire strategy and demolition plan requested by name as brief C0 and C2; drawing register as C7.

Untagged stair glazing - the stair windows are the only glazing on K1653-11/12 carrying no W1 or W2 tag, while every habitable-room window has one. They sit outside the tagged system, which is probably why the vents were never scheduled, and it bears on whether the drawings' 1.6 U-value binds them (RFI-6).

Cavity closers, cavity trays and jamb DPCs at the vent openings - CHECKED AND CORRECTLY NOT OURS (Gordon Court, 27/07). These accessories sit in NBS F30 'Accessories/sundry items for brick/block/stone walling', a MASONRY section, not L10 windows - so they are the bricklayer's even where a new opening is formed. Recorded as a knowing exclusion rather than a silent gap. Riverside's external walls are of unestablished construction (no build-up legend), so if they prove to be cavity these items will exist and belong to the builder's work package.

Intumescent perimeter seal - CHECK RUN, NOT APPLICABLE. NBS L10 cl.790 'Fire-resisting frames' requires the gap between frame and reveal to be filled with INTUMESCENT mastic or tape, and L10 is the windows section, so on fire-rated frames it is the glazing scope and ordinary mastic in a fixings line does not comply (Gordon Court, 27/07). Not applicable here: the AOVs are smoke vents in the EXTERNAL wall of a protected stairwell, so the perimeter seal is weathering, not compartmentation - fire separation on this building runs between the stair and the flats (FD30s doors, fire collars, separating wall upgrades), not through the external envelope. A Plus quote no fire rating and none is specified for these frames. Our priced external mastic at 10.64 lm x GBP 5 stands. Re-check if any vent is ever relocated into a compartment wall.

Structural design for a new opening in retained masonry - NO STRUCTURAL ENGINEER IS NAMED anywhere on the six drawings we hold. The notes name a heating engineer and an electrician and otherwise defer to site: 'CONTRACTOR TO ESTABLISH EXACT DRAINAGE LAYOUT', 'TO BE SITE AGREED WITH HEATING ENGINEER/ELECTRICIAN & TO SUIT BUILDING INSPECTOR APPROVAL', 'ELECTRICAL LAYOUTS ARE TO BE SITE AGREED WITH CLIENT'. So the opening Adam authorised enlarging may have neither a structural design nor a price behind it. Engineer's investigation drawings (brick/mortar sampling, GPR) requested at C2 - on a refurbishment that is where the wall build-up normally lives, and it is a different request from asking the architect.

performance.required: Free area 1.0 m2 per stairwell (drawings K1653-11 and K1653-12), basis geometric or aerodynamic NOT stated on the drawing
performance.evidence: A Plus state GEOMETRIC 1.30 m2 per vent on QT51518 and give no aerodynamic figure. On their QT51516 (Towcester Vale, same DualFrame 75Si AOV) aerodynamic runs 60-62% of geometric (0.49/0.81 and 0.54/0.87). On that ratio 1.30 geometric is ~0.78-0.81 aerodynamic, ~20% short of 1.0. Complies on geometric, fails on aerodynamic. A Plus have not been asked for the aerodynamic figure for these sizes - RFI-1. EVIDENCE ADDED 27/07 EVENING, POINTING TO GEOMETRIC: (a) the drawings name their own compliance route - the key on K1653-10b/11/12 reads 'MAINS OPERATED INTERLINKED HEAT DETECTOR TO AD B1', i.e. the prescriptive Approved Document B route, which expresses common-stair smoke vents as a free area; aerodynamic free area is the language of the engineered BS 9991 / EN 12101-2 route, which this pack is not on. (b) Gordon Court's NBS 9001 L20 cl.630 specifies the standard product for this exact duty as 'AXS140 STAIRWELL VENTILATOR - throat 1250mm x 1000mm - 1m2 GEOMETRIC free area', and 'aerodynamic' appears nowhere in that job's 186-page NBS, 140-page mechanical or 127-page electrical spec. Recommendation is geometric, so the vents as quoted comply by 30% - but capable stays unconfirmed because only the fire engineer or building control can rule on the basis. Requote brief written and ready to settle it either way: outputs/Riverside House - A Plus requote brief (for Gintare).txt. CONFIGURATION RESOLVED 27/07 LATE: the quoted 1.30 m2 reconciles exactly with the full inner frame aperture, 957 x 1357 = 1.2986 m2 (1357 = 1530 less two 86.5mm sections, 86.5 from the 957 daylight width). So the geometric free area quoted IS the clear opening of the whole frame, which means the entire frame opens as one bottom-hung leaf with the 176mm transom acting as a glazing bar within the sash - consistent with a single 850mm chain on a frame whose individual apertures are only 590mm high. Also passes Gordon Court's ratio flag: required 1.0 / 1.729 gross = 57.8%. RATIO CAVEAT 27/07 LATE: Gordon Court have WITHDRAWN the 'above ~60% of gross frame' rule of thumb after recomputing their own unit on the aperture (WN_7 went from 'cannot reach 1.5 m2' to 99.3% of it). Use the aperture, not the gross frame - but note an aperture is normally INFERRED from a nominal section depth, including ours (86.5mm from (1130-957)/2), so it is an estimate and not a compliance test. The clear opening is A Plus's figure to state. APERTURE SENSITIVITY, 27/07 late: Gordon Court quantified the caveat - on their unit a +/-5mm change in an assumed nominal section swings the answer across the compliance line (65mm 101.1%, 70mm 99.3%), so no aperture percentage is a compliance test. Accepted. The direction of inference differs here though: they PREDICT an unstated clear opening from an assumed section; we RECONCILE a figure A Plus published. Across head+cill from 150mm to 200mm our reconciliation moves only 101.6% to 97.9% of the stated 1.30 m2, and there is no line to cross - the test is whether it holds, not whether it passes. The configuration conclusion is robust; it stays an inference until A Plus confirm it (brief item 5).

performance.required: U-value 1.6 W/m2K, per the key on drawings K1653-10b/11/12 (W1, W2 and D1 all carry 1.6)
performance.evidence: QT51518 states a CENTRE-PANE glass figure only - '4-20-4 Clr Tough S Coat 1.2' - and no whole-window Uw. A Plus's own advisory notes set their default the other way: 'Unless otherwise stated, windows and doors will have a U-Value no better than 1.8.' Whether the 1.6 key value binds the stair AOV (which is called out only by the red smoke-vent note, not lettered W1/W2) is itself unconfirmed. Nobody has asked A Plus for a Uw - RFI-6.

u_value.note: The drawings key states 1.6 against each window/door TYPE (W1, W2, D1, D5) rather than as a package average, so it reads per element. No energy or sustainability appendix is present in the pack to test against (the St Mary's / Gordon Court check) - the pack is 6 planning and construction-issue drawings only.

delivery_terms.note: A Plus batch sub-GBP5,000 loads to avoid charges and only levy GBP1/mile each way where batching is not possible, so the amount is contingent, not fixed. Carried as provisional pending A Plus confirmation - RFI-7. Note the resize option removes it: at 1235 x 1583 the order clears GBP 5,000 and delivery is FOC. AND THE DESTINATION IS NOT SITE. QT51518 carries no site address at all - the only address on it is Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd, 97-98 Alston Drive, Bradwell Abbey, MK13 9HF. So 'Glazed /Supply Only (Delivered)' means delivered to our own yard in Milton Keynes, not to Aylesbury, and the onward leg is ours. Gordon Court found the same on all five of their supplier quotes.
